name: Underwater Places
description: Several structure mods rework the sea floor.

pages.title: Underwater Places
pages.text: Several structure mods rework the sea floor. They are destinations for a [#](2E5AAC)[submarine](entry://ocean/submarines)[#](): ruins, wrecks and monuments with better loot than vanilla. Pressure matters, so check depth with a [#](2E5AAC)[Barometer](entry://ocean/hulls_and_pressure)[#]() first.

pages.title: Ocean Monuments
pages.text: YUNG's Better Ocean Monuments rebuilds the vanilla monument. Prismarine can be crushed for lapis and XP.

**Hopo Better Underwater Ruins** and **Revamped Shipwrecks** both replace vanilla ruins and shipwrecks with larger, more varied builds. **MOS (Moog's Ocean Structures)** adds many more: Atlantis ruins, temples, sunken ships, dragon skeletons, gardens and shrines.

pages.title: How Often
pages.text: The sea floor is tuned to about **three times vanilla's underwater rate**, so a few hundred blocks of open ocean usually hold several places. The common finds (small ruins, shipwrecks, whale falls) each get about the same share. Builds with the best loot stay rare on purpose: MOS temples and Atlantis ruins, monuments and the Hopo sunken city.

Smaller finds round it out: **whale falls** (Hybrid Aquatic), ocean **wreckage** (Towns and Towers), sunken **boats** (Creat Aeronautics Structures), flooded ruins from Create: Let The Adventure Begin, and **conduit ruins**. The **Ice Maze** of [#](2E5AAC)[Aquamirae](entry://ocean/aquamirae)[#]() keeps its ice spires and arches at full density, because they are the biome itself; its frozen wrecks are thinned like the other common wrecks.

Chests in them are normal loot, so remember [#](2E5AAC)[Lootr](entry://exploration/lootr)[#](): in this pack, loot chests are per player. Conduit and prismarine gear from these places feeds the machines in [#](2E5AAC)[Conduit Cages](entry://ocean/conduits)[#]().

pages.title: Conduit
pages.text: A conduit in a monument can be worked with Aquatic Ambitions' fan channeling.
